links.outcome: Reading grade level of chatbot patient education materials on chemotherapy cardiotoxicity
links.effect: Mean reading grade level across all chatbots was 13.7; ChatGPT 14.2, Copilot 14.0, Gemini 12.5, Meta 14.2, despite high understandability (median PEMAT 91.7%).
links.quote: Mean reading grade level (RGL) across all chatbots was 13.7.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education materials versus appropriate patient reading level
links.effect: Mean RGL 13.7 across chatbots (12.5 to 14.2), described as poor readability for patient materials.
links.quote: AI chatbots produce high quality PEM with poor readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and quality of patient education materials generated by four LLM chatbots without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
